gen-irish-grover-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its lines at a steady thickness, a tidy sans-serif with open curves. Irish Grover sits above it looking sturdy and a bit playful, its softly shifting strokes making a friendly, hand-bent foil for the body's crisp finish.
gen-irish-grover-gf-carrois-gothic: Irish Grover puts out tall, sturdy lowercase with softly shifting stroke weights and open, generous curves. And Carrois Gothic is the tidy one, a modern sans with a high x-height that keeps text crisp where the heading goes for personality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Chunky, friendly and slightly wobbly, Irish Grover leads with tall letters that look built to last. Carrois Gothic SC follows in a sans-serif where capitals and lowercase nearly match, and every curve ends in a clear opening that keeps paragraphs moving.
gen-irish-grover-gf-chivo: Chivo reads as a plain sans with lowercase packed tight toward the capitals and daylight showing through every curve. Irish Grover's tall, sturdy letters make a lively headline above it, and a generous size for the heading would suit.
gen-irish-grover-gf-chocolate-classical-: Tall, sturdy and a bit goofy. Irish Grover has the personality with its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, while Chocolate Classical Sans does the quiet work of a sizable, broad-nibbed plain sans that never curls shut.
gen-irish-grover-gf-comme: Tall, sturdy lowercase gives Irish Grover a chunky, hand-shaped presence, with stems barely heavier than the arms that join them. Comme sits beneath as a smooth sans-serif, its lowercase filling nearly the whole letter height.
gen-irish-grover-gf-cossette-texte: Sturdy, friendly and softly shaded, Irish Grover brings tall lowercase with open throats and gentle contrast in every curve. Cossette Texte answers with a plain sans whose wide-eyed e and prominent x-height keep curves as thin and steady as a drawn thread.
gen-irish-grover-gf-duru-sans: Big, friendly and softly shaded, Irish Grover stands up tall with open throats and moderate contrast in its strokes. Duru Sans follows as a modern sans-serif whose wide-opened small letters dominate the line while its ascenders barely show.
gen-irish-grover-gf-fresca: Tall lowercase that looks sturdy and large is what defines Irish Grover, with joins and terminals just slightly lighter. Fresca steps in with wire-like, tubular sans-serif letters, short ascenders over big bowls, and no calligraphic thinning anywhere.
gen-irish-grover-gf-funnel-sans: Irish Grover stacks sturdy, tall lowercase with open throats and a gentle ebb and flow in its stroke thickness, set against a tidy body. Funnel Sans keeps its sans strokes uniform from stem to curve.
